description: Search the Arkansas Code BY TOPIC or keyword over official section catchlines (section titles), not citation — e.g. "capital murder", "security deposit", "concealed carry". Returns matching citations and catchlines; call ar_statute with a citation for the full text. Catchline search only (not full statutory- text search) — a query that never appears in any catchline will return no matches even if the underlying topic is discussed inside a section's body. Sourced from the same 2020-11-06 release as ar_statute. Keyless.

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 50.

name: ar_search
